cohort: The study participants were women who experienced an obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) between 2013 and 2015 at a tertiary academic medical center.
finding: The median interpregnancy interval (IPI) for women with a prior obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) was 26.4 months, which is similar to the IPI for the general population in Ohio and the United States.
mod_finding: Among women with a prior OASI who had a subsequent vaginal delivery, 2.4% experienced a recurrent OASI.
followup_time: Median 64.0 months for women without a subsequent pregnancy, with data collected up to 2021 for all participants.
